div.div:
After his death, Duan Fei regressed 20 years back in time to those key hours before the virus catastrophe was set off. Now he'll have a chance to remedy the regret he has shouldered for those 20 long years. He will utilize all the knowledge he brought back from his previous life to prepare for the oncoming apocalypse. His newly acquired ‘Evolutionary Tree” will help him continue to grow stronger. Duan Fei was just a survivor in his previous life, now he will be the hero and the savior of the world in this life.
(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

As the author of "Swordmaster Sade", Cha Sung-Min had no idea how dangerous his plot-hole-riddled novel could be until he's reborn as Rasen Mayton, a spoiled side character destined to die at 17. As if being stuck in the body of a rude scumbag despised by everyone wasn't enough, Sung-Min also discovers that he was reborn at a point before his story began. With almost no knowledge about the current timeline, will Sung-Min be able to survive in this unwritten world as House Mayton's youngest?
(Source: Tapas, edited)
